name: cartoon-site
description: Static site for the cartoon company. The repo's filesystem is the CMS: /cartoons and /canon are read at build time.

scripts.predev: node scripts/validate-character-canon.mjs && node scripts/prebuild.mjs && node scripts/build-studio-library.mjs && node scripts/build-studio-reports.mjs
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/validate-character-canon.mjs && node scripts/prebuild.mjs && node scripts/build-studio-library.mjs && node scripts/build-studio-reports.mjs
scripts.test:studio: node scripts/test-studio-library.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/test-studio-reports.mjs tests/studio-part-approval.test.mjs tests/studio-desk.test.mjs && node --test scripts/test-studio-reports-live.mjs scripts/test-studio-library-snapshot.mjs scripts/test-studio-library-cast.mjs scripts/test-prepare-studio-preview.mjs scripts/test-studio-notes.mjs
